messages.subject: lodcolumn
parts:
I am a novice just working through the Broman guide to QTL mapping with
R/qtl. I would like to plot a scan of 3 phenotypes but I get the following
error when I try this code:

out.all <- scanone(F8oxoli, pheno.col=1:3)
summary(out.all, threshold=3, format="allpeaks")
plot(out.all, lodcolumn=1:3, col=c("blue", "red", "green"), chr=(2, 5, 6, 7,
8), ylim=c(0,28.5), ylab="LOD score")

Error: unexpected ',' in "plot(out.all, lodcolumn=1,3, col=c("blue", "red"),
chr=(2,"

Are you able to see what I'm doing wrong?

Thanks so much for any help.

Angela.

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] lodcolumn
parts:
The code doesn't match the error.

The error is that you write lodcolumn=1,3 rather than lodcolumn=c(1,3)

karl
